text:
marco (PM): dropping a new direction for the Alerting -> SLO config panel. goals: make thresholds explicit, make notification preview compact but discoverable, clarify "silences" language. figma: https://figma.redwood/alerts/new-flow
lee (Product Design): love the goal. initial idea: present severity presets as chips (Info / Warn / Critical) with a small pXX summary under each chip. chips are quick taps, but a "Custom" action opens inline editor. keep the presets discoverable but not forced.
nina (Frontend): implementation notes: prefer chips over select for quicker keyboard navigation. for channel preview we should show recipient avatars (svg) + a fallback avatar with initials. lazy-load full avatars after render to avoid blocking. also we'll limit visible avatars to 2 then show a "+N" pill that expands on click.
marco (PM): on the +N expansion — do we show a dropdown, tooltip, or inline expandable list? needs to be accessible and not cause layout shift.
lee (Product Design): inline collapsible list that overlays (position: absolute) so no layout shift. trigger is keyboard-focusable and has aria-expanded. label the trigger "Show N more channels". include channel type icons (email, slack, pagerduty) next to names.
sam (A11y): key a11y asks: 1) ensure the "+N" trigger is reachable by keyboard and announced as a button; 2) the preview area should update an aria-live region when the selected preset changes so screen readers get feedback; 3) the simulate-notify action must be a modal with role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus trapped, and an accessible close button.
nina (Frontend): for preview updates we'll debounce change events by 300ms and populate the aria-live text with short phrases like "Preview updated: sends to 2 channels". avoids screen reader spam.
lee (Product Design): copy swap: replace "suppression" with "Silences" everywhere in the inline controls. microcopy under the silence toggle: "Silences stop outgoing notifications but keep the alert in history for auditing." short, plain.
marco (PM): product wants a toast when a preset is overridden. suggested toast: "You edited the threshold. This alert no longer follows the 'Critical' preset. Undo". include an Undo CTA.
nina (Frontend): backend contract: store both preset and override. API shape request we want to show to API team:
```
{
  "preset": "critical_v2",
  "override": "p95>1.2s"
}
```
lee (Product Design): small UX detail: show the explicit numeric value next to the preset chip when it's active, e.g., "Critical — p95 > 1.5s". when overridden show a subtle badge "custom".
sam (A11y): color contrast: make sure chips meet 4.5:1; focus styles are visible (not just color change). Also keyboard flow: Tab into chips, arrow keys move selection, Enter toggles custom editor, Esc closes. When the custom editor opens move focus to the first input and announce "editing custom threshold" via aria-live polite.
ui-bot: snapshot ready: https://images.redwood/snap/1769123456-01.png
marco (PM): one last ask: timeline preview (incident history) is expensive. for now show a static example graphic with a "Live timeline coming soon" badge in the preview. we'll revisit after perf work.
lee (Product Design): okay I'll update the mock with the inline overlay for +N, the toast wording, and the silence helper copy. ping me when you push so I can run accessibility review.
marco (PM): thanks team. leaving this open for any last blockers. :thumbsup:
